transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's get our weekly readiness huddle underway. We have one maintenance bay and one training yard available this week, and Alpha, Bravo, and Delta are all competing for time on both. I need to hear current constraints and required commitments from each of you before I publish the schedule by close of business today. Motor pool, training, and signal reps -- please go ahead and report your current constraints and any required commitments we need to factor in.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Ma'am, I need to flag a required commitment for the maintenance bay. Two Alpha section vehicles require brake inspections in the maintenance bay on Monday at 0800, and they must be cleared before Alpha's Thursday movement. The work order is in the motor pool log but hasn't been added to the company schedule yet.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Ma'am, I need to flag a required commitment for the training yard. Delta section has a certification evaluation on Thursday at 0800, and the evaluator's confirmation arrived after the current training calendar was printed. Delta must have the training yard from Tuesday at 1300 through 1600 for its final vehicle-handling rehearsal. This needs to be factored into the schedule.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: Ma'am, I need to flag a required commitment from Signal. I received a higher-headquarters directive requiring the company to complete a radio interoperability check on Monday at 1500. This check must be completed before any Tuesday movement. The directive is awaiting entry into the signal annex and has not yet been placed on the company schedule.
transcript.speaker: A4

commitments.detail: Two Alpha section vehicles receive brake inspections Monday at 0800 in the maintenance bay, cleared before Alpha's Thursday movement.
Delta section has the training yard Tuesday 1300-1600 for final vehicle-handling rehearsal ahead of Thursday 0800 certification evaluation.
Radio interoperability check conducted Monday at 1500 per higher-headquarters directive, completed before any Tuesday movement.
